_doc: Injuries. A character holds {injury_id: days_left}; time heals them day by day. cultivation_mult multiplies qi gathering, combat_mult multiplies max_hp/attack/defense; several injuries stack multiplicatively. Suffering an injury you already have resets it to the longer of the two durations. sources: when an injury may be inflicted. Table entries may set min_realm (a realm id): below it the entry is skipped, so higher-realm injuries only strike higher-realm cultivators. chance is the base probability (reduced by (fortune - 10) * fortune_step), table picks which injury by weight. Pills heal with the Effects key heal_injury: an injury id, or "all". treatment_cost: spirit stones a clinic charges to heal it fully (scaled by days left). medicine: Doctor rules (see medicine.gd); npc_treatment_days/npc_treatment_favor/npc_healed_favor (extra favor when the injury is fully healed)/npc_treatment_alignment apply when treating an injured NPC. The npc_mishap source is rolled monthly for every adult NPC (chance scaled by the fraction of a month simulated).

injuries.name: Qi Deviation
injuries.description: Qi runs wild through your meridians. Cultivating is slow and painful.

injuries.name: Damaged Meridians
injuries.description: Your meridians are torn. Qi leaks out faster than you can gather it.

injuries.name: Broken Bones
injuries.description: Several bones are broken. Fighting is out of the question.

injuries.name: Internal Injury
injuries.description: A blow bruised your organs. You cough blood when you exert yourself.

injuries.name: Meridian Rupture
injuries.description: Foundation-level qi tore through meridians too narrow to hold it. Every breath of qi burns.

injuries.name: Cracked Dantian
injuries.description: A hairline crack runs through your liquid foundation. Qi seeps out as fast as you gather it.

injuries.name: Spirit Burn
injuries.description: Scorched by a foe's qi, your skin and channels blister. It hurts to raise a hand in battle.

injuries.name: Soul Scar
injuries.description: A wound on the soul itself. Your divine sense flickers, and meditation brings nightmares.

injuries.name: Demonic Qi Corrosion
injuries.description: Foul demonic qi lodged in your body eats at your meridians from within.

injuries.name: Golden Core Fissure
injuries.description: A fissure runs across your golden core. Push it too hard and it may shatter.

injuries.name: Sundered Body
injuries.description: Bones shattered and flesh torn by a Core Formation blow. You can barely stand, let alone fight.

injuries.name: Heart Demon
injuries.description: The devoured cultivator's dying will lingers in your sea of consciousness, whispering while you meditate and clouding your moves in battle.
